mapper.sql: id, target_type, target_id, status, contract_address, metadata_uri, metadata_json, metadata_hash, fact_hash, token_index, block_height, confirmed_at, retry_count, next_attempt_at, error_code, revoked_at, created_at, updated_at

target.id, target.target_type, target.target_id, target.status, target.contract_address, target.metadata_uri, target.metadata_json, target.metadata_hash, target.fact_hash, target.token_index, target.block_height, target.confirmed_at, target.retry_count, target.next_attempt_at, target.error_code, target.revoked_at, target.created_at, target.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_nft_issuances () VALUES (#{id}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{status}, #{contractAddress}, #{metadataUri}, #{metadataJson}, #{metadataHash}, #{factHash}, #{tokenIndex}, #{blockHeight}, #{confirmedAt}, #{retryCount}, #{nextAttemptAt}, #{errorCode}, #{revokedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}) ON CONFLICT (target_type, target_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: WITH due AS ( SELECT id FROM tb_nft_issuances WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND (next_attempt_at IS NULL OR next_attempt_at <= #{now}) ORDER BY created_at, id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE tb_nft_issuances target SET status = 'SUBMITTING', contract_address = CASE target.target_type WHEN 'BADGE' THEN #{badgeContract} ELSE #{credentialContract} END, next_attempt_at = NULL, updated_at = #{now} FROM due WHERE target.id = due.id RETURNING
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_nft_issuances SET status = #{next.status}, contract_address = #{next.contractAddress}, metadata_uri = #{next.metadataUri}, metadata_json = #{next.metadataJson}, metadata_hash = #{next.metadataHash}, fact_hash = #{next.factHash}, token_index = #{next.tokenIndex}, block_height = #{next.blockHeight}, confirmed_at = #{next.confirmedAt}, retry_count = #{next.retryCount}, next_attempt_at = #{next.nextAttemptAt}, error_code = #{next.errorCode}, updated_at = #{next.updatedAt} WHERE id = #{next.id} AND status = #{expected}
UPDATE tb_nft_issuances SET updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expected}

UPDATE tb_nft_issuances n SET revoked_at = #{now} WHERE n.revoked_at IS NULL AND ((n.target_type = 'CREDENTIAL' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_credentials c WHERE c.id = n.target_id AND c.status IN ('REVOKED', 'SUPERSEDED'))) OR (n.target_type = 'BADGE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_learning_badges b WHERE b.id = n.target_id AND b.status = 'REVOKED')))
